title: APPROVE REVOCABLE PERMIT NO. 26-09 WITH LOS ANGELES FIRE DEPARTMENT HISTORICAL SOCIETY
text:
RESOLUTION NO. ____________ - APPROVE REVOCABLE PERMIT NO. 26-09 WITH LOS ANGELES FIRE DEPARTMENT HISTORICAL SOCIETY
Transmittal 1
Transmittal 2
Summary
: Staff requests approval of Revocable Permit No. 26-09 with the non-profit Los Angeles Fire Department Historical Society (Historical Society) for use of City of Los Angeles Harbor Department (Harbor Department) property consisting of approximately 6,496 square feet of space located at 444 South Harbor Boulevard, San Pedro, CA 90731 to store and display the Ralph J. Scott Fireboat. This proposed action will advance the Port’s Strategic Plan objective 4, strong relationships with stakeholders, by providing museum space dedicated to the history of marine fire services, which is expected to attract visitors to the LA Waterfront. Historical Placement of the Ralph J. Scott Fireboat on Harbor Department property has provided, and it is anticipated to continue providing, numerous public benefits to the Port of Los Angeles, including creating a draw for locals and tourists to visit the LA Waterfront; enhancing San Pedro’s maritime ambiance; complementing nearby waterfront attractions; boosting overall cultural tourism; and showcasing firefighting history and maritime technology. Staff expects that the public benefits received by the Port of Los Angeles will exceed the amount of rent being waived. Therefore, staff recommends waiving rent for Revocable Permit No. 26-09.
Recommendation
: Board resolve to 1) find that the proposed action is exempt from the requirements of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under Article III Class 1(14) of the Los Angeles City CEQA Guidelines as determined by the Director of Environmental Management; 2) find that the value of services delivered to the community exceeds the market rental value of the property, and the rent that would be due and owed imposes an understandable hardship; 3) approve Revocable Permit No. 26-09 with the Los Angeles Fire Department Historical Society; 4) authorize the Executive Director to execute and the Board Secretary to attest to Revocable Permit No. 26-09; and 5) adopt Resolution No. ____________.
